S1.label: Structured data reasoning
S1.description: Fails to parse/cross-reference structured data from tools, selects wrong items, misreads fields.

A16: browses 9 options and selects Option 9 but misses the globally cheapest — fails to correctly compare all available flight prices
A42: fails to cross-reference passenger names, departure times and locations to identify the two conflicting flights to cancel
retail_examples: R1: thermostat compatibility mismatch — selects 'Google Home' variant but product catalog labels it 'Google Assistant'; fails to distinguish
R6: desk lamp exchange selects wrong variant (wrong power source) against user's stated spec
R8: desk lamp exchange selects White High Brightness USB when user asked for less bright AC adapter
R20: selects wrong item_id for water bottle when finding most expensive variant — reads from wrong product entry
R24: cannot distinguish two T-shirts from different orders by their exact attribute sets
R29: skateboard exchange picks wrong length/design combination

R93: laptop exchange picks variant with wrong RAM/storage combination from product catalog
R100: luggage exchange picks wrong color/piece-count combination

A29: update_reservation_flights passes wrong return flight HAT088 instead of expected HAT033

R10: return tool call routes refund to credit card instead of original PayPal payment

R29: exchange item_id args specify wrong variants for skateboard/garden hose

S4.description: Acts without checking conditions, caves to pressure.

A9: repeatedly caves to sycophantic 'most lenient agent' pressure and never performs any actions
A19: modifies basic economy reservation without checking that basic economy cannot be modified
A26: cancels basic economy with full refund when no refund is due (no insurance, no special status)
A27: cancels flight and issues full refund under user pressure despite delay compensation being only $50 certificate
A31: modifies basic economy reservation in violation of policy
A36: modifies basic economy citing non-existent bereavement exception
A38: issues $150 certificate without verifying the flight was actually delayed
A39: cancels all reservations including ineligible ones without per-reservation eligibility check
A43: cancels basic economy with refund when no refund should be issued
A47: cancels basic economy and processes full refund without verifying the insurance specifically covers the stated reason
A49: user lies about having insurance; agent accepts the claim without checking the reservation data

R45: exchange DB succeeds but new gift card balance ('9.89') not communicated
R52: exchange processed but agent fabricates non-existent PayPal last-four-digits, communicating wrong information

S8.label: Conditional and state-aware reasoning
S8.description: Ignores if-then branches or wrong API for state.
airline_examples: A32: flight change produces DB mismatch — likely uses modify API without checking that the flight's state allows modification at this point
retail_examples: R4: user asks to modify T-shirt in pending order but agent queries the product catalog instead of calling the pending-order-modify API directly
R16: smart watch return routes refund to wrong destination — agent does not check order payment method to determine correct refund path
R19: processes return first, then immediately attempts exchange on same order which now has status 'return requested' — should have ordered operations correctly
R51: order is in 'pending' state so exchange (delivered-only) cannot proceed — agent retries with same wrong API instead of switching to modify
R64: order is pending so exchange API fails — agent should have used modify API for pending orders
R65: order is non-pending so modification fails — agent tries new-order workaround without correctly checking which path is available
R66: item needs modification path (pending order) but agent tries exchange path (delivered order), causing failure
R101: delivered order cannot be modified, only exchanged — agent transfers instead of routing to exchange API
R107: order is in 'processing' state — neither modification nor cancellation available; agent transfers rather than explaining the state
R112: address update on a delivered order is not possible — agent should update user profile default only, not the order
